UserInteraction.title: User Interaction
UserInteraction.description: A single journal entry, reflection, or conversation with Gemini strictly isolated to an authenticated user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the interaction document

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

title.description: Descriptive title or heading for the journal entry

prompt.description: The user's journal reflection, thought, or inquiry

aiResponse.description: Gemini's generated reflection, feedback, or summary

mode.description: The mode of interaction: reflection, summary, brainstorm, or chat

tags.description: Tags associated with the reflection for easy search

updatedAt.description: ISO string timestamp of last update

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: User-isolated document storage for saving reflections, journal entries, and Gemini conversations.
